messages.author: Ivo March, program lead
messages.body: Authoritative revision 4 supersedes Copperfield Mail revision 3. Cancel LHP-ASTER. Move LHP-BOREAL to 11:00–12:00 in Juniper. LHP-CINDER depends on Boreal; schedule its 30-minute session in Juniper at the earliest permitted start, no earlier than 13:00. Lunch from 12:00–13:00 is a hard hold. LHP-DUNE still requires exactly 14:30–15:00 in Sable. Do not move protected holds or invent another room. If a request is unschedulable, use blocker LHP-C17 and escalate it to program-lead. All constraints in this message are hard.

messages.author: Tess Rowan
messages.body: Friday coffee moved to the south patio.
